card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token partway through a number, usually the last or second-to-last digit of a figure like 121, 489 or 18.7. It appears in measurements, percentages and counts in both web text and drug labels.

modes.label: Digit in whole number
modes.description: A digit completing or continuing a multi-digit integer before a unit or comma.
modes.example: capable of travelling great distances (up to 75 miles/12<<1>> km)

modes.label: Digit after decimal point
modes.description: A digit following a decimal point in a percentage or measurement.
modes.example: Over half of Nepal’s children (55.<<7>>%) defecate in open spaces.

card.plain: It lights up on a digit in the middle or end of a longer number, such as the 7 in 55.7%.
